<script setup lang="ts" generic="Type extends 'text' | 'number' = 'text'">
import { PinInputRoot, type PinInputRootEmits, type PinInputRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PinInputRootProps<Type>>(), {
  modelValue: () => [],
});
const emits = defineEmits<PinInputRootEmits<Type>>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <PinInputRoot
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('flex gap-2 items-center', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </PinInputRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const props = defineProps<PrimitiveProps>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    :class="cn('flex items-center', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { PinInputInput, type PinInputInputProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const props = defineProps<PinInputInputProps>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <PinInputInput
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    :class="cn('relative text-center focus:outline-2 focus:outline-ring focus:-outline-offset-1 focus:relative focus:z-10 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center border-y border-r border-input text-sm transition-all first:rounded-l-md first:border-l last:rounded-r-md', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DotIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';

const props = defineProps<PrimitiveProps>();
const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive v-bind="forwardedProps">
    <slot>
      <DotIcon class="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
    </slot>
  </primitive>
</template>
